description: Department of Local Government (Southern Province) - The meeting for the purpose of electing the Deputy Mayor
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the convening of a meeting to elect a Deputy Mayor for the Hambantota Municipal Council. It is made under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and specifically references election-related legislation (Elections for Local Government Bodies (Amendment) Act No. 22 of 2012). The content focuses entirely on electoral procedures and scheduling for local government bodies, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
